key_idea: Add up all four sides. Each colored corner gets counted twice.
steps: Each side adds to 15, so the four sides together make 15 + 15 + 15 + 15 = 60.
The numbers 1 to 8 add up to 36. That counts every circle once.
In the 60, each colored corner is counted twice, once for each of its sides. So the colored circles add up to 60 - 36 = 24.

choice_feedback.A: The colored circles must make up the extra 60 - 36 = 24, not 16.
